content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a service that allows users to host websites directly from a GitHub repository. For digital creators, it represents an opportunity to create a free and sustainable online store without relying on traditional payment platforms that often impose high fees. Unlike Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, using GitHub Pages in conjunction with NOWPayments means you only incur a fee of 0.5%. This difference can be substantial, especially for creators selling high-value products, ultimately allowing for greater profitability and financial independence in an increasingly restrictive digital commerce landscape.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using GitHub Pages for hosting a digital product store involves several components working in unison. Initially, you set up a GitHub repository, which serves as the base for your website. GitHub Pages renders this repository as a static site. Then, you can integrate backend functionalities through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which handle tasks like order fulfillment and automated delivery of digital products. Finally, incorporating NOWPayments facilitates seamless cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This architecture ensures a robust, low-cost, and efficient method of running your online store while maintaining full ownership of your assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically tailored for digital creators in countries where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or any digital product, GitHub Pages paired with NOWPayments offers an accessible infrastructure for your commerce needs. It caters to those who prioritize ownership and control, allowing you to operate without the restrictions or fees imposed by platforms like PayPal or Gumroad. By utilizing this architecture, creators can focus more on building their products and less on navigating the complexities of traditional payment systems.
GitHub Pages enables free, independent hosting for your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of this digital commerce architecture relies on several key components. First, GitHub Pages serves as the hosting platform, providing a free and reliable foundation for your site. Next, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers act as the backend logic, allowing you to manage orders and automate product delivery. Supabase can be utilized for order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensures secure and efficient file delivery. Finally, integrating NOWPayments enables seamless payment processing without the need for customer accounts or KYC regulations. When these components are assembled effectively, they create a cohesive and powerful platform for selling digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital product store using GitHub Pages, begin by creating a GitHub repository where your site will be hosted. Once the repository is set up, configure GitHub Pages in the repository settings to make your site live. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order management and automate product delivery. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets for storing order data securely. Afterward, leverage Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept payments with minimal fees. For a comprehensive guide to all of these components, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), offering all the resources needed for a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
NOWPayments ensures low transaction fees at just 0.5%.

This article connects to searches regarding selling digital downloads without platform fees and provides insights into a sovereign commerce stack. For those looking to build a comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all necessary blueprints and templates. Check out our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

What are the benefits of using GitHub Pages for my store?
GitHub Pages offers free hosting, full ownership of your content, and the ability to customize your store without reliance on traditional payment processors.
How does NOWPayments work for processing transactions?
NOWPayments allows you to accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies with a low fee of 0.5%, ensuring that transactions are seamless and quick.
You maintain complete ownership of your digital store and assets.
